content:
The Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB) has issued an Exam Date Change Notice for Group-2 Sub Group-1 Krashi Vistar Adhikari (Agriculture Extension Officer) Recruitment Test 2026.

Total vacancies: 2,784. Applications were accepted from 03 July 2026 to 17 July 2026 (correction window as per rulebook).

Exam date revision

  • Earlier schedules mentioned early August 2026 CBT windows
  • As per the latest Exam Date Extended / Revised notice (around 31 July 2026), the examination is rescheduled to start from 17 September 2026
  • Always verify the final shift-wise timetable from the official PDF on esb.mp.gov.in

What candidates should do

  • Download the official exam date change notice and revised rulebook pages
  • Wait for admit card link (usually a few days before the exam)
  • Do not rely on the old August date for travel plans

Official portal: esb.mp.gov.in.
